findings.location: Translation paragraph about short verse example (source HTML third visible paragraph after second block)
findings.source_quote: I thought young children memorized short verses like, “Be ye kind one to another.”
findings.suggested_fix: Use a more natural Norwegian phrasing for this idiom. Replace «Vær gjensidig vennlige» with «Vær vennlige mot hverandre» to preserve meaning and improve idiomatic clarity.
findings.translation_quote: Jeg tenkte at små barn lærte korte vers som «Vær gjensidig vennlige».

findings.location: Translation paragraph about John 19 passage (paragraph starting "Jeg ble nysgjerrig...")
findings.source_quote: Easter was approaching so I started working with them on the crucifixion account found in John 19:1-19.
findings.suggested_fix: Consider a slightly more literal phrasing for "crucifixion account" to match the source's neutral narrative tone. Replace «forkynnelsen om korsfestelsen» with «korsfestelsesberetningen i Johannes 19:1-19» to mirror the source wording and keep the descriptive, non-preaching tone.
findings.translation_quote: Påsken nærmet seg, så jeg begynte å arbeide med dem på forkynnelsen om korsfestelsen i Johannes 19:1-19.
